title: Butterfly Lovers
synopsis: This is our elementary level adaptation of the classic Chinese legend “Butterfly Lovers”.

fullText.simplified:
“喜欢！我很喜欢她！”大山太高兴了，他在房间里走来走去。他想到小英做了他的妻子，他们就能每天都在一起了，那是多么快乐的事情。
    钱红看到大山那么高兴，也为他高兴。她说：“好了，大山。你现在知道怎么做了，对吗？快去吧，小英在等着你。”
    “我知道了，谢谢钱阿姨！你太好了！”大山很高兴地说。

    我们再来看看小英。小英回到家，周妈妈很高兴地说：“小英，快来！妈妈告诉你，爸爸为你找了一个好丈夫。他是马家的儿子，好像也和你在一个学校。你们在一起，会很快乐的。”
    小英听后，没有像周妈妈想的那样很高兴，她看着周妈妈，问道：“什么？你们为我找了一个丈夫？我不要！我有喜欢的人！”
    “什么你喜欢的人。一个女孩子，说这话，你不会觉得不好意思吗？”周爸爸很不高兴地说。
    “我不要你们找的丈夫。你们都不为我想想，你们都没有问我想要什么样的丈夫。什么马家，我不要！我有喜欢的人，我要做他的妻子！”周小英大叫道。
    “你的丈夫就是要我们帮你找的啊，你看看别人家的女孩，她们的丈夫都是她们的爸爸妈妈帮找的啊！再说了，我们为你想了啊。马家，是那个地方的有钱人家，你去那里，就和在家里一样，做饭、做菜都有下人做，你要什么有什么，多好？马家的儿子马文，他和你一个学校，他是你的同学，你们在一起，有说不完的话，多好！”周妈妈想让女儿知道，他们都是为了她好。
    “马文？你说要我做马文的妻子？”周小英跳了起来。
    “对啊，马文。前两天，马爸爸来我们家，说起他的儿子在百书学校读书。我们一想，帮你找一个你的同学做你的丈夫，你会很高兴。所以，我们就和马爸爸说好了，让他的儿子做你的丈夫。”周妈妈说。
    “不可以！我死也不要做马文的妻子。”周小英快哭了。她想到在百书学校的时候，马文打她，笑她。在学校里，她最不喜欢的就是马文，怎么能做他的妻子？
    “你喜欢也好，不喜欢也好。一个月后，你就是马文的妻子了。我们什么事情都可以听你的，就是这次不可以。”周爸爸说完，走了。
    周妈妈看着小英，说：“好孩子！听话！马文会对你好的。马家是有钱人家，和他们说好的事情，我们现在喜欢也好，不喜欢也好，都要去做。要不马家会很不高兴。让马家不高兴，我们家就完了。你知道的，对吗？”说完，周妈妈也走了。
    小英一个人坐在床上，哭了。她很想大山：不知道钱阿姨有没有告诉大山我是女孩？不知道大山是不是也喜欢我？

    錢紅看到大山那麼高興，也為他高興。她說：“好了，大山。你現在知道怎麼做了，對嗎？快去吧，小英在等著你。”
    “我知道了，謝謝錢阿姨！你太好了！”大山很高興地說。

    我們再來看看小英。小英回到家，周媽媽很高興地說：“小英，快來！媽媽告訴你，爸爸為你找了一個好丈夫。他是馬家的兒子，好像也和你在一個學校。你們在一起，會很快樂的。”
    小英聽後，沒有像周媽媽想的那樣很高興，她看著周媽媽，問道：“什麼？你們為我找了一個丈夫？我不要！我有喜歡的人！”
    “什麼你喜歡的人。一個女孩子，說這話，你不會覺得不好意思嗎？”周爸爸很不高興地說。
    “我不要你們找的丈夫。你們都不為我想想，你們都沒有問我想要什麼樣的丈夫。什麼馬家，我不要！我有喜歡的人，我要做他的妻子！”周小英大叫道。
    “你的丈夫就是要我們幫你找的啊，你看看別人家的女孩，她們的丈夫都是她們的爸爸媽媽幫找的啊！再說了，我們為你想了啊。馬家，是那個地方的有錢人家，你去那裡，就和在家裡一樣，做飯、做菜都有下人做，你要什麼有什麼，多好？馬家的兒子馬文，他和你一個學校，他是你的同學，你們在一起，有說不完的話，多好！”周媽媽想讓女兒知道，他們都是為了她好。
    “馬文？你說要我做馬文的妻子？”周小英跳了起來。
    “對啊，馬文。前兩天，馬爸爸來我們家，說起他的兒子在百書學校讀書。我們一想，幫你找一個你的同學做你的丈夫，你會很高興。所以，我們就和馬爸爸說好了，讓他的兒子做你的丈夫。”周媽媽說。
    “不可以！我死也不要做馬文的妻子。”周小英快哭了。她想到在百書學校的時候，馬文打她，笑她。在學校裡，她最不喜歡的就是馬文，怎麼能做他的妻子？
    “你喜歡也好，不喜歡也好。一個月後，你就是馬文的妻子了。我們什麼事情都可以聽你的，就是這次不可以。”周爸爸說完，走了。
    周媽媽看著小英，說：“好孩子！聽話！馬文會對你好的。馬家是有錢人家，和他們說好的事情，我們現在喜歡也好，不喜歡也好，都要去做。要不馬家會很不高興。讓馬家不高興，我們家就完了。你知道的，對嗎？”說完，周媽媽也走了。
    小英一個人坐在床上，哭了。她很想大山：不知道錢阿姨有沒有告訴大山我是女孩？不知道大山是不是也喜歡我？

sentences.simplified: 我们什么事情都可以听你的，就是这次不可以。”周爸爸说完，走了。
sentences.traditional: 我們什麼事情都可以聽你的，就是這次不可以。”周爸爸說完，走了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men shén me shì qing dōu kě yǐ tīng nǐ de jiù shì zhè cì bù kě yǐ zhōu bà ba shuō wán zǒu le
sentences.english: We could listen to you no matter what, but it can’t be done this time." Father Zhou finished talking and left.

sentences.simplified: 周妈妈看着小英，说：
sentences.traditional: 周媽媽看著小英，說：
sentences.pinyin: zhōu mā ma kàn zhe xiǎo yīng shuō
sentences.english: Mother Zhou looked at Xiao Ying, and said:

sentences.simplified: “好孩子！听话！马文会对你好的。
sentences.traditional: “好孩子！聽話！馬文會對你好的。
sentences.pinyin: hǎo hái zi tīng huà mǎ wén huì duì nǐ hǎo de
sentences.english: “Be a good child! Do as you’re told! Ma Wen will be good to you.

sentences.simplified: 马家是有钱人家，和他们说好的事情，
sentences.traditional: 馬家是有錢人家，和他們說好的事情，
sentences.pinyin: mǎ jiā shì yǒu qián rén jiā hé tā men shuō hǎo de shì qing
sentences.english: The Ma family is a wealthy household. When you have made an agreement with them about something, ..

sentences.simplified: 我们现在喜欢也好，不喜欢也好，都要去做。要不马家会很不高兴。
sentences.traditional: 我們現在喜歡也好，不喜歡也好，都要去做。要不馬家會很不高興。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men xiàn zài xǐ huan yě hǎo bù xǐ huan yě hǎo dōu yào qù zuò yào bù mǎ jiā huì hěn bù gāo xìng
sentences.english: .. whether we like it or not right now, it must be done. Or else the Ma Family will be very unhappy.

sentences.simplified: 让马家不高兴，我们家就完了。你知道的，对吗？”
sentences.traditional: 讓馬家不高興，我們家就完了。你知道的，對嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: ràng mǎ jiā bù gāo xìng wǒ men jiā jiù wán le nǐ zhī dào de duì ma
sentences.english: If we make the Ma family unhappy, our family is finished. You know that, right?”

sentences.simplified: 说完，周妈妈也走了。
sentences.traditional: 說完，周媽媽也走了。
sentences.pinyin: shuō wán zhōu mā ma yě zǒu le
sentences.english: After she had finished talking, Mother Zhou also left.

sentences.simplified: 小英一个人坐在床上，哭了。
sentences.traditional: 小英一個人坐在床上，哭了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng yí ge rén zuò zài chuáng shang kū le
sentences.english: Xiao Ying sat alone on the bed and cried.

sentences.simplified: 她很想大山：不知道钱阿姨有没有告诉大山我是女孩？
sentences.traditional: 她很想大山：不知道錢阿姨有沒有告訴大山我是女孩？
sentences.pinyin: tā hěn xiǎng dà shān bù zhī dào qián ā yí yǒu méi yǒu gào su dà shān wǒ shì nǚ hái
sentences.english: She really missed Dashan: I don’t know if Aunt Qian has told Dashan that I’m a girl or not?

sentences.simplified: 不知道大山是不是也喜欢我？
sentences.traditional: 不知道大山是不是也喜歡我？
sentences.pinyin: bù zhī dào dà shān shì bú shì yě xǐ huan wǒ
sentences.english: I wonder if Dashan also likes me or not?

raw.synopsis: This is our elementary level adaptation of the classic Chinese legend “Butterfly Lovers”.
sentence_translations: “Yes! I like her very much!” Dashan got very happy, he walked back and forth in the room.
He thought of Xiao Ying being his wife, they could be together each and every day, how happy things would be.
Qian Hong saw how happy Dashan was, and was also happy for him.
She said: “Well then, Dashan. Now you know what to do, right? Go quickly, Xiao Ying is waiting for you.”
“I know, thank you Aunt Qian! You're awesome!” Dashan said very happily.
We come round to see Xiao Ying again.
Xiao Ying came back home, and Mother Zhou said very happily:
“Xiao Ying, come quick! Mother has something to tell you, Father has found a good husband for you.
He is the son of the Ma family, and it seems like he also was at the same school as you.
You will be very happy together.”
When Xiao Ying heard this, she wasn’t as happy as Mother Zhou thought. She looked at Mother Zhou, and asked:
“What? You have found a husband for me? I don’t want that! I have someone I like!”
“What’s this about someone you like. A girl, saying these words, don’t you feel embarrassed?” Father Zhou said very unhappily.
“I don't want the husband you found.
You haven’t even thought about me, and you haven’t even asked me what kind of husband I want.
I don’t want anything to do with the Ma family!
I have someone I like, I want to be his wife!” Zhou Xiao Ying shouted.
“Your husband is someone we have to help you find.
Look at girls in other families, their fathers and mothers helped find all of their husbands!
Moreover, we did think about you.
The Ma family is a wealthy family in that area.
If you go there it will be just like at home, all the preparing and cooking of meals is done by servants.
You can have whatever you want, how good is that?
The son of the Ma family Ma Wen, he was at the same school as you.
He’s your classmate, you’ll never run out of things to talk about together, how excellent!”
Mother Zhou wanted to let her daughter know that they were only acting for her good.
“Ma Wen? You’re saying that I’m to be Ma Wen's wife?” Zhou Xiao Ying jumped up.
“That's right, Ma Wen.
Two days ago, Father Ma came to our home and mentioned that his son studied at The School of a Hundred Books.
We thought that helping you find one of your classmates to be your husband would make you very happy.
Therefore, we made the agreement with Father Ma, to have his son be your husband.” Mother Zhou said.
“It can’t be! I’d rather die than be Ma Wen's wife.” Zhou Xiao Ying was almost crying.
She thought of when Ma Wen had beaten her and made fun of her at The School of a Hundred Books.
Ma Wen was the one she liked the least in school, how could she be his wife?
“It’s done whether you like it or not. One month from now, you will be Ma Wen’s wife.
We could listen to you no matter what, but it can’t be done this time." Father Zhou finished talking and left.
Mother Zhou looked at Xiao Ying, and said:
“Be a good child! Do as you’re told! Ma Wen will be good to you.
The Ma family is a wealthy household. When you have made an agreement with them about something, ..
.. whether we like it or not right now, it must be done. Or else the Ma Family will be very unhappy.
If we make the Ma family unhappy, our family is finished. You know that, right?”
After she had finished talking, Mother Zhou also left.
Xiao Ying sat alone on the bed and cried.
She really missed Dashan: I don’t know if Aunt Qian has told Dashan that I’m a girl or not?
I wonder if Dashan also likes me or not?
